objective: Determine whether Nova can play long buffered sequences continuously without explicit STOP between logical groups.

tests.title: Nine-record baseline
tests.purpose: Verify the conservative normal runtime window has no internal physical pause.
tests.summary: 9 alternating balls in one START at 1 Hz
tests.question: Did the robot physically pause anywhere inside this nine-ball sequence?

tests.title: Sixteen records in one START
tests.purpose: Probe beyond the conservative normal runtime window without any intermediate STOP.
tests.summary: 16 alternating balls in one START at 1 Hz
tests.question: Did all 16 balls run, and was there any physical pause inside the sequence?
